text: CRITICAL DISPATCH: Heavy monsoon stormwater and Mithi drainage backflow have submerged Shell Colony lowland arterial under 75cm to 85cm of stagnant water. Standard ambulances stalled. Roadway asphalt eroded. Complete corridor impassable to wheeled vehicles.
action_required: Enforce mandatory perimeter closure at Chembur Naka. Reroute all hospital-bound emergency ambulances east via VN Purav Marg or the elevated Eastern Freeway.

incident_type: Expansion Joint Shear Slip on Amar Mahal Flyover
text: STRUCTURAL ALERT: Amar Mahal Flyover northern elevated ramp expansion joint has sheared 14cm following foundation soil subsidence. Severe transverse beam displacement with exposed rebar. Catastrophic dynamic collapse risk under dynamic vehicular loads.
action_required: Total closure of Amar Mahal north ramp. Prohibit all emergency crossings. Direct north-bound heavy emergency convoys via Panjarpol Eastern Freeway elevated link.

incident_type: Substation Submersion & Power Failure at Inlaks Hospital
text: FACILITY ADVISORY: Inlaks General Hospital basement power substation completely flooded. Emergency diesel backup generators drowned. Operational capacity compromised to 3%; only 2 triage beds available. ICU ventilators on emergency battery reserve (<30 mins remaining). Non-viable for trauma intake.
action_required: Divert all trauma and critical casualties exclusively to Zen Multi Speciality Hospital (N_HOSP_ZEN) or Surana Sethia Trauma Centre (N_HOSP_SURANA).

incident_type: Downed 11kV Cables & Mud Washout on Shell-Suman Link
text: HAZARD REPORT: Mud accumulation and downed 11kV overhead lines across Shell Colony South connector near Suman Nagar. Live electrical arcing reported near water pooling.
action_required: Isolate Tata Power grid sector. Barricade Suman-Shell connector. Emergency access to Surana Hospital must utilize direct Suman Nagar Hospital Way.

incident_type: Heavy Congestion on Pestom Sagar North Link
text: TRAFFIC CAUTION: Severe bumper-to-bumper vehicular diversion on Pestom Sagar North Link due to Amar Mahal ramp blockade. Narrow bottleneck slowing transit.
action_required: Enforce emergency lane clearance for ambulances.

incident_type: Clear Elevated Corridor Verified on Eastern Freeway
text: RECON CLEARANCE: Aerial thermal scanning confirms Eastern Freeway Panjarpol elevated span is dry, structural pillars intact, and completely clear of flood waters. Ideal high-speed emergency corridor.
action_required: Designate Eastern Freeway as primary heavy convoy artery connecting Chembur and RCF Trombay sector.
